channel.title: Worldview Weekly
channel.description: A weekly global counterweight reading feed: concise, analytical, low-noise, and deliberately broader in perspective than The Economist.

item.title: The Future, Made in China — The New Yorker
item.description:
The New Yorker · August 10, 2026 issue · long (~40 min)

Evan Osnos reports from China on the cumulative payoff from decades of industrial policy, infrastructure, scientific investment, automation and increasingly capable AI. The piece takes Chinese technological strength seriously while also dwelling on the political control, demographic weakness, labor disruption and brittle state-society bargain beneath it.

Counterweight: Complicates a market-efficiency account of China by showing where state capacity has produced real technological gains.
